categories.main_business_segments: Beilong Precision Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision structural components. Its main product lines serve the smartphone sector, including lens barrels, camera module components, and motor parts, as well as non-smartphone sectors such as wearable devices, smart security, and automotive electronics. The company also extends its precision manufacturing capabilities to other fields like laptops and drones.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced mold design and manufacturing, automation, and integrated process technologies. Key proprietary technologies include Insert Molding & Mounting Technology (IMMT), Liquid Silicone Rubber (LSR) injection molding, and combined Insert Molding & LSR processes. It emphasizes high-precision mold development with tolerances down to microns, automated production lines, and smart manufacturing systems to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Beilong serves leading global enterprises in consumer electronics, including major smartphone manufacturers and suppliers such as Sunny Optical, Amphenol, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, TDK, Hikvision, and Dahua Technology. Its products are used in smartphones, wearable devices (smartwatches, TWS earbuds, AR/VR glasses), smart security cameras, and automotive electronics, particularly in advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Zhejiang Province. It serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 19% of revenue from exports. Its global customer base includes multinational corporations in Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beilong operates as an upstream to midstream supplier in the precision structural components segment of the electronics supply chain. It provides customized, high-precision parts and modules directly to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, focusing on manufacturing complex components that integrate into end products like smartphones and automotive cameras.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in precision mold design, automation, and new material processes such as IMMT and LSR. R&D efforts focus on product miniaturization, integration, and enhanced reliability, especially for VCM motor components and optical modules. It also invests in smart manufacturing and lean management to reduce costs and improve responsiveness. Future plans include expanding into AR glasses, automotive connectors, and smart security lenses.
categories.revenue_model: Beilong generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized precision structural components and modules to large OEM customers. It operates on a build-to-order model driven by customer contracts, with no intermediary distribution. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading precision structural components manufacturer in China, recognized as a national manufacturing champion and a 'specialized and innovative' enterprise. It competes in a highly fragmented but technologically demanding industry, differentiating itself through advanced R&D, high product precision, and strong customer relationships with industry leaders. Competitors include other precision component suppliers in the electronics and automotive sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Beilong reported revenues of approximately RMB 402 million, a 5.65% increase over 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 37.9 million, down 34.75% year-over-year due to pricing pressures and increased R&D and depreciation expenses. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 878 million and equity of RMB 743 million, reflecting significant growth and capital raising through a 2024 IPO. R&D investment increased by 9.64% to RMB 25.5 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beilong emphasizes high-precision, high-complexity structural components with micron-level tolerances, rapid product development cycles, and stable mass production capabilities. Its proprietary mold technologies and integrated manufacturing processes enable cost-effective, high-quality products that enhance optical performance and reliability for end customers. The company’s close collaboration with leading OEMs and focus on innovation provide a competitive edge in meeting evolving market demands.
